title: Spectra config
description: The settings of a2ui-spectra.json, the optional config file in the directory Spectra is launched from, or the file --config names.

$schema.description: This schema's address, for an editor. Spectra ignores it.

url.description: The agent's base address, starting with http:// or https://. With it, attach's <agent-url> argument and run's --agent-url option may be left out; given, they take precedence.

headers.description: Headers the message box adds to every request it makes to the agent, the card fetch included. ${VAR} in a value is replaced from Spectra's environment, so the file holds variable names, never values. The box's own transport headers win over a header of the same name.

catalogs.description: Paths of catalog definition files, each carrying its own catalogId. A relative path is relative to this file's directory. Read once at start; a change needs a restart.

preview.description: The preview pages: the URL of each page built with a Spectra preview adapter, starting with http:// or https://.

tools.description: The agent's tool servers, MCP over HTTP or plain HTTP, each reached through the tool proxy on its own port. run sets each variable to the tool proxy's address, and attach prints it.

variable.description: The environment variable the agent reads the server's URL from, such as FLOOR_PLAN_SERVER_URL. A POSIX name, used once, and none of the model proxy's five variables.

url.description: The server's URL, starting with http:// or https://, such as http://127.0.0.1:8000/sse. When Spectra's environment sets the variable to another address, that value is the server's URL instead.

prices.description: Prices for the viewer's estimated cost, keyed by the model id as requested, such as gemini-3.6-flash, in USD per million tokens. An entry replaces LiteLLM's entry for that model whole, and prices a model LiteLLM's table does not know.

input.description: USD per million input tokens that were not read from or written to the cache.

output.description: USD per million output tokens, reasoning tokens included.

cacheRead.description: USD per million input tokens read from the cache. Without it, they are priced as input.

cacheWrite.description: USD per million input tokens written to the cache. Without it, they are priced as input.
